title: Minimal Ice Boat Racing
description: An extremely lightweight ice boat racing modpack for the average person with a potato PC.
body:
An extremely lightweight (100+ FPS on integrated graphics!) ice boat racing modpack for the average person with a potato PC.

Included:
- All the essentials: OpenBoatUtils, Boatcam, BBBoatHud, etc.
- Additional extras (server integration mods and more): BoatLabs mod, Racing Scoreboard, WLC mod, Xaero Map and minimap etc.
- Performance mods: Sodium, Lithium, etc.
- Dependencies

Feel free to unlink and use as a base for your own IBR modpack!
